summary: Align tradition badges/colors with the real corpus: dynamic badges from DB + rekey tokens.tradition to actual corpus traditions
description: Homepage badges (and tokens.tradition app-wide color map) were out of sync with the corpus: 3 keys (vedanta, kabbalah, mysticism) don't exist in corpus.chunks, and the corpus's biggest traditions (egyptian, greek_mystery, western_esoteric, christian_mysticism, jewish_mysticism, zoroastrianism, etc.) were missing — so those citations rendered in fallback grey. Fix: add server helper listTraditions() (DISTINCT tradition FROM chunks, by prominence), make homepage badges dynamic from the DB (no hardcoded fallback per the no-fallbacks rule), and rekey tokens.tradition to the 16 real corpus slugs with colors. Also drop the false 'Vedantic consciousness' from the hero tagline.

resolution.note: Badges now dynamic from DISTINCT tradition FROM chunks (16 real traditions, prominence order); tokens.tradition rekeyed to real corpus slugs (fixes citation/settings colors); tagline no longer claims Vedanta. Verified: lint, type-check, 454 tests, build, and browser (badges render real traditions, no vedanta/kabbalah/mysticism).
